q1_issues.issue: The announce attitude takes (Agent sk_announce_1 devil_rays), but the propositional-attitudes rule prescribes Experiencer for the holder of a say/announce-class verb with a clausal complement.

Inside the sealed complement, (Member sk_problem_1 personal) and (Member sk_problem_1 unspecified) predicate descriptive modifiers of the group symbol itself, which the plural rules explicitly forbid — they must distribute to the members.

(PartOf josh_hamilton devil_rays) asserts an organizational-membership link that the text only names as a noun modifier inside 'Devil Rays prospect', and a noun modifier is never exposed as its own atom.

'is in doubt' is stored twice in two incompatible shapes — an entity-attached (In sk_future_1 doubt) plus a reified state (Member sk_doubt_1 doubt)/(Experiencer sk_doubt_1 sk_future_1) whose class is the noun from inside the PP rather than a property.

q2_gaps: predicative PP as a copular complement ('X is in doubt') — there is no licensed head for a non-locative PP predicate, and no licensed class for its reified state
causal 'because of' + NP ('because of unspecified personal problems') — the connectives section reifies two clauses as endpoints and says nothing about a causal preposition taking an entity
proper-noun modifier in a role compound ('Devil Rays prospect Josh Hamilton') — the compound rules cover adjective and common-noun modifiers, and the proper-noun exclusion covers only the name itself
notes: BecauseOf is borderline but reads as licensed, being CamelCase-joined from the preposition actually used. The Experiencer/Agent call is itself a conflict in the instruction set: the attitudes section says Experiencer, while the progressive test under Thematic roles makes 'announce' an ordinary event with an Agent subject.
